parsed.claim_reason: The claim is false: the exhibited infinite pairwise-intersecting family of finite sets admits infinitely many distinct inclusion-minimal finite transversals.
parsed.witness_reason: Each T_k meets F_n via y_n for n<k and via x_k for n>=k. Deleting any y_i misses F_i, while deleting x_k misses F_k, so every T_k is inclusion-minimal.
